audit_items.proof_trace: The local validator publishing path (proposer.go:502) calls ReceiveDataColumns directly, bypassing setSeenDataColumnIndex. This creates cache divergence: locally published columns exist in storage but NOT in the anti-equivocation cache, violating the invariant that all imported columns must update the cache.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A malicious validator publishes block B1 with data columns DC1 via RPC (storage updated, cache NOT updated). Then publishes conflicting block B2 with different columns DC2 for the same slot via gossip. The hasSeenDataColumnIndex check (validate_data_column.go:157) returns false (cache miss), allowing DC2 to pass validation. Both conflicting columns now exist in storage, achieving equivocation without cache detection.
